authority: #K2-341 sec.2 (authorised method (i): dedicated re-route of the trapped runs) -> sec.2.3 exhaustion clause
trapped: 2 high-speed vias + 4 track pieces of PCIE_DN4_N / PCIE_DN5_P (MCIO fan-out runs, In5, ~48 mm)

attempts.method: rect-clip (6x6 corner keepout) + C17 v1 re-route
clearance-aware via push (attach-aware, 0.30 mm criterion, 4.0 mm bounded search, 8 directions)

result.note: the moved via lands in a FOREIGN-NET COPPER POUR; re-attached segments were checked, pours were not

attempts.method: as C but with the pours added to the obstacle model (bbox-conservative test)

result.why: no clear position inside 4.0 mm (both vias)

attempts.caveat: the pour test is bounding-box based (conservative): this is a NAMED EXHAUSTION of the local-push method, not a proof of geometric impossibility

root_cause: the bottom-right corner is a dense HS fan-out region whose inner layers carry foreign-net pours; any via placed there to vacate the keepout must clear those pours, and no such position exists within the local push envelope

fix_options.what: dedicated re-route of the two In5 runs: rip the full runs and re-route with the maze router (needs precise pour polygons in the obstacle model + a stronger re-route mode)
owner-declared deviation: H4 stays at 3.18 mm (6% over the 3.0 rule) while H1/H2/H3 sit exactly on it

consequence_for_the_scheme_gate.scheme_layer: P1 PASS / P2 PASS / P3 FAIL (H4 only) / P4 PASS (complete=true)
consequence_for_the_scheme_gate.note: three of four corners are exactly on the rule; the framework freeze is deferred to the owner decision on this item
